name: Power in Numbers
body:
School: transmutation; Level: cleric/oracle 2, druid 3, paladin 2, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3
Casting Time: 10 minutes

CASTING

Components: V, S

EFFECT

Range: close (25-ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets: one creature/level in a 30-ft.-radius spread
Duration: 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance: yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

This spell improves an entire group’s strength, making them all stronger than they would be individually. The affected group of creatures gain a +1 morale bonus to melee damage rolls and AC per 2 creatures under the effect of this spell. If the affected creatures are goblins, kobolds or other small or smaller sized creatures, two creatures may occupy the same space without penalty.
